scope: Manual visual review of six plots, three 12-frame contact sheets (36 total samples) and six full-resolution frames 0.2s after first actual push; sampled review, not every video frame. Full encoding/probe checks are separate.
findings: All sampled views retain the full body with consistent segment colors and connected joints.
All six motion frames show visible attached feet and plausible recorded poses; push times and analysis-window timeline agree with selected trial metadata.
Control front frame 0 has visible ground grain; later contact samples and full-resolution push frames are clear. This inherited byte-identical clip does not obscure the robot.
Six plots are legible and distinguish descriptive post-treatment speed bins from causal evidence. Primary CI crosses zero and the acceptance plot reports failure.
limitations: Videos replay recorded root pose/world velocity/joint position without new physical rollout; display joint velocities are zero. Recovery labels use analysis ages 0..49, not the critic feature inclusive age 50.
